answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. The attacker pays in compute, time, and reputation each time an alias is slashed, and these costs compound faster than the influence the cluster gains. Consider a plume at the center, a yarrow resting nearby, and a forge beyond the hills: three anchors, none forged, all earned over time.
